roadmap.title: Story playthrough (any difficulty)
roadmap.description: Clear the prologue and all 16 chapters on any difficulty. These 16 story achievements are automatic and nothing is missable, so this run can double as the base for the completion cleanup.

roadmap.title: Majima Saga
roadmap.description: Play the three Majima Saga chapters from the main menu, unlocked as the main story passes Chapters 5, 8 and 11.

roadmap.title: Substories and Amon
roadmap.description: Complete the 75 substories across both cities and both time periods, then finish the Amon chain for the final substory.

roadmap.title: Cabaret Club Grand Prix
roadmap.description: Run Club Four Shine through the five Grand Prix leagues, recruiting hostesses and dining with the platinum hostesses along the way.

roadmap.title: Majima Construction (Clan Creator)
roadmap.description: Finish the 17 Clan Creator missions, recruit more than 50 workers and farm 200,000 points.

roadmap.title: Street bosses, bouncer missions and Coliseum
roadmap.description: Clear every street boss, all 78 bouncer mission runs and all 12 Coliseum tournaments, including the two gated by Clan Creator and all substories.

roadmap.title: Base stats and Limit Break
roadmap.description: Raise Health, Attack, Defense and the Heat Gauge to their natural caps with EXP, break a stat limit, then max all four stats.

roadmap.title: Skills and videos
roadmap.description: Buy every Life, Battle and Heat Action skill, collecting the Technique Primers and viewing the videos that unlock the moves.

roadmap.title: Completion List and city exploration
roadmap.description: Finish the six Completion List categories and the remaining city counters: restaurants, drinks, lockers, minigames, photographs, donations, wealth and 100 weapon defeats.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough
roadmap.description: Replay the 16 chapters on Legend difficulty from the game-clear save, with stats, gear and money carried over.

roadmap.title: Final achievement
roadmap.description: Claim the completion reward once the other 58 achievements are earned.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other Yakuza Kiwami 2 achievement.

guide.context: The reward tracks the other 58 entries and has no separate requirement, so it unlocks automatically as the final outstanding achievement is earned.

steps.text: Earn the other 58 achievements on this list; the reward unlocks with the last one.

achievements.summary: Complete all three chapters of the Majima Saga.

guide.context: The Majima Saga is a separate three-chapter story launched from the main menu and set between Yakuza Kiwami and Yakuza Kiwami 2. Its chapters unlock as the main story passes Chapter 5, Chapter 8 and Chapter 11, and the saga must be played in addition to the main story.

steps.text: Start the Majima Saga from the main menu once the main story has reached Chapter 5.
Clear Chapters 1, 2 and 3, returning to the main story to unlock Chapters 2 and 3 at Chapters 8 and 11.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 until its results screen appears.

guide.context: Bouncer Missions, the Clan Creator storyline and the Coliseum all open during this chapter.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 5 until its results screen appears.

achievements.displayName: There Can Only Be One Dragon

steps.text: Play through Chapter 15 until its results screen appears.

achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 16, the final chapter of the main story.

guide.context: The main story runs for 16 chapters. The achievement appears on the results screen after the final boss and the closing events.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 16 by playing its story through to the end.

achievements.description: Completed the game in Legend mode.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story on Legend difficulty.

guide.context: Legend difficulty unlocks only after clearing the story once, and it can be started from game-clear data so stats, gear, weapons and money carry over. Enemies deal more damage and checkpoints between missions are removed, so a defeat forces a reload of the last manual save.

steps.text: Load the clear save, start a new playthrough and select @mechanic{Legend} difficulty.
Play all 16 chapters, saving from the menu before long fights and bosses.
On defeat, reload the most recent save instead of continuing; the achievement appears after the final chapter.

guide.note: Equipping @item{Photon Blade}, @item{Illegal Poison Kodachi} and @item{Dragon SP} with healing items stocked makes the run far easier.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substories are side stories marked by speech-bubble icons on the city map, and the @mechanic{Substory Finder} Life Skill makes every available one appear. They unlock by chapter across Kamurocho and Sotenbori, so 10 accumulate during normal play.

steps.text: Complete any 10 substories across Kamurocho and Sotenbori.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 substories.

guide.context: The @mechanic{Substory Finder} Life Skill marks available substories on the map. Substories unlock by chapter in both cities, and anything unfinished can still be completed in @mechanic{Premium Adventure} after the story.

steps.text: Complete 30 substories across both cities.

achievements.summary: Complete all 75 substories.

guide.context: There are 75 substories in total, and finishing them all spawns a 76th entry that completes automatically. They appear by chapter across Kamurocho and Sotenbori, and a few need a specific minigame result: the golf substory needs the intermediate Closest to the Pin challenge and the batting substory needs the three beginner Home Run challenges. Unfinished substories remain available in @mechanic{Premium Adventure}.

steps.text: Buy the @mechanic{Substory Finder} Life Skill so available substories appear on the map.
Complete every substory in Kamurocho and Sotenbori, checking both cities as chapters progress.
Finish any remaining substories in @mechanic{Premium Adventure} after the story.

guide.note: Watch the Completion List for the last missing entries, since substories are listed there in a fixed order.

achievements.description: Completed 10 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: The Completion List is opened from the Pause menu and splits into Adventure, Battle, Substories, Minigames, Clan Creator and Cabaret Club. Ten entries fall out of ordinary story progress and city exploration.

steps.text: Complete any 10 items across the Completion List categories.

achievements.description: Completed 30 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 30 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: Completion List items cover city counters, battle feats, substories, minigames and the two side businesses. The substory and minigame categories supply the bulk of the 30.

steps.text: Complete 30 items across the Completion List categories.

achievements.description: Completed 50 items on the Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 items on the Completion List.

guide.context: At 50 items the list is roughly half done and the remaining work concentrates in the substory, minigame and gambling counters.

steps.text: Complete 50 items across the Completion List categories.

achievements.summary: Complete 100% of the Completion List.

guide.context: The list requires all six categories in full: Adventure, Battle, Substories, Minigames, Clan Creator and Cabaret Club. Substories and Minigames take the longest, gambling cheat items from lockers simplify the casino counters, Mahjong only needs a set number of Tsumo or Ron wins, and Adventure includes 45 of Haruka's Requests. Everything must reach 100% on one save file.

steps.text: Finish the Adventure, Battle and Substories categories.
Finish every minigame counter, using gambling cheat items for the casino games.
Finish the Clan Creator and Cabaret Club categories, then clear any remaining counters for 100%.

achievements.summary: Learn every Battle Skill.

guide.context: Most Battle Skills unlock by leveling base stats, and several need a @item{Technique Primer} read from the inventory first. The primers come from minigame prizes and substories, and four late skills depend on other content: Strong Charge Attack Mastery on winning every Coliseum tournament, Triple Quickstep on defeating every street boss, Weapon Mastery on a primer plus all substories, and Essence of the Brawling God on clearing every bouncer mission.

steps.text: Raise all base stats so the stat-gated Battle Skills become purchasable.
Collect every Technique Primer from the Batting Center, the Golf Center, Haruka's Requests Rank SS, Kamiyama's Substory #41 and Substories #23, #25, #26, #27, #61, #62, #63 and #64.
Read each primer and buy the move it unlocks, then purchase every remaining Battle Skill.

guide.note: Reading a primer only makes its move available; the EXP cost still applies.

achievements.summary: Learn every Heat Action.

guide.context: Heat Actions arrive from three places: Technique Primers read from the inventory, Komaki's training lessons, and the Ultimate Essence earned by completing every substory. Kamiyama's videos also unlock a few Heat Actions.

steps.text: Read the Technique Primers that unlock Heat Actions and buy them.
Complete Komaki's training lessons.
Complete all substories to earn Ultimate Essence, then buy every remaining Heat Action.

achievements.summary: Learn every Life Skill.

guide.context: Life Skills cover movement, digestion and EXP gain plus the Club Four Shine and Majima Construction abilities. Buying @mechanic{Boost Exp Gain}, @mechanic{Substory Finder} and @mechanic{Boost Digestion} early speeds up the rest of the completion run.

steps.text: Open the Abilities menu and buy every Life Skill, including the Cabaret Club and Majima Construction entries.

guide.note: Each skill costs its listed EXP type, so bank experience from story fights, substories and eating.

achievements.summary: Donate a total of 1,000,000 yen to Sunflower Orphanage.

guide.context: Donations are made at the ATM in any convenience store. Each transfer is capped at 100,000 yen, so the menu must be exited and reopened to reach the total.

steps.text: Use a convenience-store ATM and choose the Sunflower Orphanage donation.
Donate 100,000 yen, exit the ATM, and repeat until the total reaches 1,000,000 yen.

achievements.summary: Learn every skill available to Kiryu.

guide.context: Skill Master combines the Life Skill, Battle Skill and Heat Action sets, so it lands among the last unlocks of a completion run. Every locked move and primer must already be purchased with EXP.

steps.text: Finish the Life Skill, Battle Skill and Heat Action sets.

guide.note: The achievement appears once the final purchasable skill is bought.

achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Health to a natural 180.

guide.context: Natural stats are raised only with their matching EXP category in the Abilities menu. Gear bonuses show on the stat screen but do not count toward this total.

steps.text: Open the Abilities menu and spend Health EXP until Health reaches 180.

achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Attack to a natural 180.

guide.context: Attack is raised with its own EXP category in the Abilities menu, separate from Health, Defense and the Heat Gauge. Gear bonuses are not counted.

steps.text: Open the Abilities menu and spend Attack EXP until Attack reaches 180.

achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Defense to a natural 180.

guide.context: Defense is raised with its own EXP category in the Abilities menu. Gear bonuses do not count toward the natural value this achievement checks.

steps.text: Open the Abilities menu and spend Defense EXP until Defense reaches 180.

achievements.description: Raised the Heat Gauge to a natural 180.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Heat Gauge to a natural 180.

guide.context: The Heat Gauge is raised with its own EXP category in the Abilities menu rather than through story progress. Equipped gear does not count toward the natural value.

steps.text: Open the Abilities menu and spend Heat EXP until the Heat Gauge reaches 180.

achievements.description: Broke the limit on a base stat.
achievements.summary: Break a base stat's natural cap.

guide.context: Each stat fills a 10-step bar that resets when full. Once Health, Attack, Defense and the Heat Gauge all sit at the natural cap of 200, the Limit Break upgrade becomes available and raises the ceiling to 300. Gear can push the displayed number above 300 but does not satisfy the requirement.

steps.text: Raise Health, Attack, Defense and the Heat Gauge to 200 in the Abilities menu.
Buy the Limit Break upgrade, then raise any one of those stats above 200.

achievements.description: Raised all base stats to maximum.
achievements.summary: Raise all four of Kiryu's base stats to their maximum.

guide.context: Peak Kiryu needs Health, Attack, Defense and the Heat Gauge at the natural cap of 300, which first requires the Limit Break upgrade unlocked by filling all four stats to 200. EXP for those upgrades comes from story fights, substories, minigames, eating and Completion List items.

steps.text: Unlock Limit Break by raising all four stats to 200.
Keep spending each EXP category until Health, Attack, Defense and the Heat Gauge all reach 300.

achievements.summary: Complete the final substory, The Ultimate Assassin.

guide.context: Jo Amon's substory only appears after every other substory is finished. Three Amon clan members appear in earlier substories, Kazuya Amon, Jiro Amon and Sango Amon, and all three must be defeated before the final fight unlocks. During Jo Amon's later phase a repeated @mechanic{Heat Action} deals no damage, so carry several weapon types to trigger different ones.

steps.text: Complete the other 74 substories so The Ultimate Assassin becomes available.
Defeat Kazuya Amon, Jiro Amon and Sango Amon in their own substories.
Win the final fight against Jo Amon, switching weapons between his phases.

achievements.summary: Defeat 100 enemies using weapons.

guide.context: Any pickup used to attack counts, including bicycles, signs, crates and weapons dropped by enemies. A knife is introduced in Chapter 1, and street fights in both cities provide a steady supply.

steps.text: Pick up a weapon such as a bicycle, sign or dropped blade.
Defeat enemies with equipped or picked-up weapons until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Play all 15 minigames at least once.

guide.context: The 15 minigames are karaoke, the gravure photo shoot, the UFO Catcher, golf, the batting cages, darts, Virtual-On, Virtua Fighter 2, shogi, poker, blackjack, and mahjong, plus Toylets, Koi-Koi and Oicho-Kabu. Only starting each one is required, so quitting immediately still counts.

steps.text: Start each of the 15 minigames once, visiting the arcades, casinos, gambling halls and sports venues in both cities.

achievements.summary: Win all 12 Coliseum tournaments.

guide.context: The Coliseum sits in Underground Purgatory and opens in Chapter 5. Health and Heat carry into a tournament, healing items are banned, and only 10% health returns after each of the first two opponents, so heal between events. Tournament of Legends unlocks after the Clan Creator story, and Tournament of Darkness after all substories.

collectibles.name: Rising Wind Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank E bare-handed tournament against rookie fighters.

collectibles.name: Lawless Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank E tournament with no restrictions.

collectibles.name: Tempest Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank D unarmed tournament, whose opponents are low-level fighters.

collectibles.name: Insane Battle Royale
collectibles.method: Win the Rank D eight-fighter battle royale; let rivals weaken each other and use the weapons dropped into the ring, since bringing your own is banned.

collectibles.name: Cataclysm Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank B bare-handed tournament against skilled fighters.

collectibles.name: Carnage Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank B tournament where you are unarmed but the opponents have weapons.

collectibles.name: Inferno Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank C weapons-allowed tournament while dodging floor flames.

collectibles.name: Shockwave Tournament
collectibles.method: Win the Rank C weapons-allowed tournament without touching the electrified cage.

collectibles.name: Inferno Battle Royale
collectibles.method: Win the Rank A battle royale with fire jets and high-level opponents.

collectibles.name: Shockwave Battle Royale
collectibles.method: Win the Rank A battle royale with an electric wall and high-level opponents.

collectibles.name: Tournament of Legends
collectibles.method: Finish the Clan Creator story to unlock it, then win the Rank A tournament whose third opponent comes from that story.

collectibles.name: Tournament of Darkness
collectibles.method: Complete all substories to unlock it, then win the Rank S weapons-allowed tournament ending against an Amon.

achievements.summary: Complete all 26 bouncer missions on Normal, Hard and Legend.

guide.context: Bouncer Missions unlock in Chapter 5 through the Kiryu the Bouncer substory and the bartender at Club Debolah. Each of the 26 missions has Normal, Hard and Legend versions; clearing Normal unlocks the next mission and its Hard version, and clearing Hard unlocks Legend. Healing items cannot be used during a mission, and the last three end against the Amon family, whose shield phase ignores a repeated @mechanic{Heat Action}.

collectibles.name: Towering Giants
collectibles.method: Clear Normal, Hard and Legend; use the pole for Heat Actions and bait the boss away from the explosive barrels.

collectibles.name: Scattered Weapons
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; carry a weapon into each wave and prioritize the boss.

collectibles.name: The Hotel District Maniac
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; slam enemies into the wrestler boss with Heat Actions and use grenade carriers.

collectibles.name: Inconvenienced Store
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; seize the bats and use the Sharp Knife from the last crate on the boss.

collectibles.name: Light Up the Black Market
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; use the Sturdy Iron Pipes and a multi-target Heat Action for the two bosses.

collectibles.name: The Wandering Swordsmen
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; use blades and alternate Essence of Tiger Crash with dropped swords.

collectibles.name: Sotenbori Purification
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; throw enemies into the river, but beat the boss normally since he cannot be thrown.

collectibles.name: The Tonfa Threat
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; draw the final boss away from his crew and watch for gunners.

collectibles.name: Questionable Crates
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties within the five-minute limit; destroy only the marked crates and ignore most enemies.

collectibles.name: Midnight Shootout
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; grab the Western Shield for the gunners and kill the boss to stop reinforcements.

collectibles.name: The Kali Stick Festival
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; equip paralysis protection and use the hammer and katana from the crates.

collectibles.name: The Unleashed Titans
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; keep away from Di Sciuva's axe and use weapon Heat Actions and grenades.

collectibles.name: Champion District Charlatans
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; grab the butcher knife and Chinese Saber crates for the two bosses.

collectibles.name: A Shady Investigation
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties within the six-minute limit; take every crate weapon and kill the katana boss first.

collectibles.name: An Explosive Plot
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties within the six-minute limit; take the upper path then the lower path and equip stun protection.

collectibles.name: Millennium Tower Showdown
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; kill the submachine-gun enemies first and bring a katana for the top-floor boss.

collectibles.name: Hidden from the World
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; bring your own blades and rush the boss before the ninjas surround you.

collectibles.name: Sotenbori Ablaze
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; wear burn protection and avoid the explosive metal barrels.

collectibles.name: A Noxious Smell
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties within the five-minute limit; kick the yellow barrels into enemies to speed up the final wave.

collectibles.name: The Sex-starved Samurai
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; grab the starting katana and keep picking up dropped weapons.

collectibles.name: Redman Returns
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; bring your own weapons and charge the finale swinging a dagger.

collectibles.name: Sotenbori Street Match
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; it is a fist-fight against Coliseum opponents, ending with Gary Buster Holmes.

collectibles.name: A Shady Investigation, Part 2
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; loot the plentiful weapons and target the ninja boss immediately.

collectibles.name: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; bring durable weapons and multi-target Heat Actions for Kazuya Amon and his escorts.

collectibles.name: Eternal Twilight
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; use the bridge as cover from Jiro Amon's gunfire and strike when his shield drops.

collectibles.name: Pandemonium
collectibles.method: Clear all three difficulties; the finale pits you against over 100 thugs and the whole Amon family, so carry several weapon types for their shield phases.

achievements.summary: Join Club Four Shine.

guide.context: The Cabaret Club storyline opens near the end of Chapter 4 and introduces the Four Shine club. The achievement appears after the introductory session.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 4 story into Club Four Shine and finish the introductory session.

achievements.summary: Register 30 hostesses on the Club Four Shine roster.

guide.context: Hostesses join through Grand Prix league wins, substory rewards and paid scouting, and the roster must hold 30 at the same time. League victories supply Kana, Aika, Shoko, Yua, Kirara and Yuki; substories supply Etsuko, The Headmistress, Miki, Yuriko and Yuka; paid scouting fills the rest.

achievements.description: Won first league championship in the Cabaret Club Grand Prix.
achievements.summary: Win a Cabaret Club Grand Prix league championship.

guide.context: The Grand Prix has five leagues and the Fresher League is the lowest and first available. A league is won by staffing hostesses and beating the rival club's sales across its rounds.

steps.text: Open the Grand Prix from Club Four Shine and enter the Fresher League.
Assign your hostesses and win the league to take the championship.

achievements.summary: Complete the Club Four Shine storyline.

guide.context: The Four Shine story ends after all five Grand Prix leagues are won: Fresher, Paradise, Executive, Millionaire and Champions. The Millionaire League limits the roster to six hostesses, and the Champions League is the hardest and depends on timing Fever Mode.

steps.text: Win the Fresher, Paradise and Executive leagues.
Win the Millionaire League while using only six hostesses.
Win the Champions League, timing Fever Mode for its closing round.

achievements.description: Lent an ear to all the platinum hostesses.
achievements.summary: Take all six platinum hostesses out for a meal.

guide.context: Club Four Shine begins with one platinum hostess and awards the other five for winning Grand Prix leagues. A wine-glass icon above a hostess means she will accept a meal invitation, and taking each platinum hostess out at least once clears the requirement.

steps.text: Win the Grand Prix leagues to collect all six platinum hostesses.
Invite each platinum hostess out for a meal whenever her wine-glass icon appears.

achievements.summary: Watch all 15 videos at the private viewing parlors.

guide.context: Watch videos at Fusion in Kamurocho or at Gandhara in Sotenbori; each 1,000-yen visit plays up to two. Three are owned from the start, Beam and Kamiyama sell the rest at 2,800 yen each, and Kamiyama's shop opens after Substory #24, A Pervy Peddler. The Filipino Ace cannot be bought until Chapter 8, once the Hayashi boss fight is done.

achievements.summary: Complete the Majima Construction introductory session.

guide.context: Clan Creator opens near the end of Chapter 5 as a Majima Construction tower-defense storyline. The achievement appears after the introductory session.

steps.text: Play the main story to the end of Chapter 5, then finish the Majima Construction tutorial.

achievements.description: Recruited over 50 workers into Majima Construction.
achievements.summary: Recruit more than 50 workers into Majima Construction.

guide.context: Workers come from four sources: paid scouting, substory characters, Coliseum opponents and defeated street bosses. Only the total must pass 50, so combining story recruits with scouting finishes it.

steps.text: Recruit substory characters, Coliseum opponents and street bosses as they become available.
Use scouting to push the worker total past 50.

achievements.summary: Complete the Clan Creator storyline.

guide.context: The storyline runs 17 missions. For the final mission, deploy a unit that has Essence of Repair, an ability that restores 20% of equipment health, and a team healer such as Hiroshi Tanahashi's I Love You to keep units alive; rocket-carrying enemies should be killed first and units moved by hand.

steps.text: Clear the 17 Clan Creator missions.
For the final mission, deploy a healer and an Essence of Repair unit, target rocket enemies first and control units manually.

achievements.description: Possessed over 200,000 points in Clan Creator.
achievements.summary: Possess more than 200,000 Clan Creator points.

guide.context: The optional Sotenbori Part 4 mission is the fastest source of points. Kazuchika Okada, recruited through recruitment flyers, has the Essence of Rainmaker ability: it costs 500 gold and multiplies collected gold by five.

steps.text: Recruit Kazuchika Okada through recruitment flyers.
Start Sotenbori Part 4, collect the first gold bar, then activate Essence of Rainmaker.
Collect the remaining gold before the wave ends, then repeat on the second gold wave near Wave 5.

guide.note: The two gold waves together push the total past 200,000 points.

achievements.summary: Open every coin locker in Kamurocho and Sotenbori.

guide.context: Each city holds 50 lockers and 50 matching keys. Kamurocho's lockers sit just southwest of Millennium Tower and Sotenbori's just south of Bishamon Bridge; keys lie on the ground as sparkles and light up only the locker they open. Kamurocho's keys are all collectable by Chapter 8, and Sotenbori's last key comes from a Chapter 10 substory.

steps.text: Collect locker keys by pressing the confirm button over the sparkles around both cities.
Open each lit locker at the Kamurocho and Sotenbori locker banks.

guide.note: Locker E3 in Kamurocho holds the Locker Key Watcher, which beeps near uncollected keys and makes the search much easier.

achievements.summary: Eat at every restaurant in Kamurocho and Sotenbori.

guide.context: Restaurant completion is tracked in the Completion List under Adventure. Haruka's Requests include many restaurant orders, so finishing them also feeds this counter.

steps.text: Order at least one dish at every restaurant in Kamurocho and Sotenbori.

guide.note: Check the Completion List restaurant entries to see which places are still missing.

achievements.summary: Take 10 photographs with Kiryu's phone.

guide.context: The phone camera is always available, and its default keyboard shortcut is C. Any subject counts, so the shots can be taken anywhere in either city.

steps.text: Open the phone camera and take a photograph.
Repeat until 10 photographs are recorded.

achievements.description: Drank all drink types from vending machines.
achievements.summary: Drink every type of vending machine drink in both cities.

guide.context: There are 49 drink types across Kamurocho and Sotenbori, sold from seven machine types whose stock differs. The 13 Mystery Drinks come only from the purple and magenta machines and are random, so a machine may need several purchases to roll every effect, and some Mystery Drinks damage health.

steps.text: Buy a drink from a vending machine and drink it.
Visit vending machines across both cities until all 49 drink types are logged, buying several Mystery Drinks from the purple and magenta machines.

guide.note: Track progress in the Completion List drink counter.

achievements.summary: Destroy an establishment three times.

guide.context: The Inconvenienced Store bouncer mission takes place inside a convenience store whose interior fixtures can be smashed across its waves.

steps.text: Start the Inconvenienced Store bouncer mission at Club Debolah in Theater Square.
Smash the store's counters, shelving and signs until the game records three destroyed establishments.

achievements.summary: Possess more than 10,000,000 yen.

guide.context: Money is held as one running total, and the Cabaret Club Grand Prix produces the largest regular income in the game. Clan Creator payouts and Completion List rewards add more.

steps.text: Run the Cabaret Club Grand Prix leagues and keep the takings.
Keep earning until the wallet passes 10,000,000 yen.

achievements.summary: Defeat every street boss in Kamurocho and Sotenbori.

guide.context: The street-boss sidequest starts in Chapter 5 when Kiryu leaves Serena. A new boss appears each time five groups of the same enemy type (Thugs, Delinquents or Yakuza) are defeated, for 15 groups of each type per city. The Charismatic Photo gear from Substory #44 makes enemy groups spawn more often.
